post_content:
Internet isn’t just for Instagram, TickTock & Youtube. Knowledge of
universities like Stanford, Oxford and rest is available on internet but Just
information isn’t enough Only the Information which is well understood,
reflected upon to understand underlying principals and applied to build real
solutions is useful. Without it, information is just noise. Without this
information is just garbage Learning to think critically, reflect on it and
apply that knowledge in real life is one of the best things anyone can learn
in life. In past 4 weeks, I have learned more about productivity than 12
years. The books I have read to learn it have been published 20 years before,
but underlying principals are the same. Fundamentals never change. And if your
foundation is strong, it would be easy to build anything on top of it. How you
learn matters more than what you learn With help of internet everyone has
access to same information, we might not have the same amount of money or
opportunities but we have the same information. And if we think creatively and
try to find ingenious ways to achieve our goals, anything is possible. Learn
to think, reflect and apply the knowledge in real life. Ability to use the
knowledge is important nothing else. hashtag#motivation hashtag#careeradvice

profile_headline: Data Scientist | Craves to Learn | Loves to Solve | Lives to teach
post_content:
A binary search tree ,decision tree , a parse tree - all three are completely
different. The mindset, knowledge representation and the thought process for
making each of the tree is completely different. Of late, I have seen Data
Scientists (CS background) ask irrelevant qns to non CS aspirants like - code
a linked list, complexity of search tree etc. I have seen best Data Scientists
from non CS background. While a CS background will be an added advantage,
don't feel bad if you aren't from CS Today. I cannot code a BST from scratch,
but I have written recommendation engines, POS tagger and chat bot from
scratch being an Electrical Engineer. The only 'Linked' which I know well is
Linkedin and not Linked list. Depth of a domain is important. Reversing a
linked list is not depth of DS . Just because Data is stored on computers and
ML is run on processor, it's not a field of computer science people ALONE PS :
This post is aimed at motivating non CS graduates to explore data world
IRRESPECTIVE of odds. Any comments talking about how CS curriculum is
inevitable for Data Science will be ruthlessly deleted in the fond memory of
CS interviewers who are rejecting candidates based on Anagram questions :P

profile_headline: Believer | Optimistic | SIES College of Management Studies
post_content:
According to the Ministry of External Affairs (Government of India), there are
an estimated 5.86 lacs Indian students studying in 86 different countries. And
more than 66% of students are staying in the USA, Canada, and Australia. In
fact, spending on tuition and hostel fees by Indians studying overseas has
gone up by 44 percent from $1.9 billion in 2013-14 to $2.8 billion in 2017-18.
STEM remained the top preferences for Indian Students. There is also a rise in
specialized courses like AI, automation and Machine Learning. And it's
expected to grow more. Is our education sector so weak that students prefer to
go abroad for further studies? There is a lot of changes left at the school
level. Students still don’t have idea about how world is changing rapidly.
Some schools are still following the traditional ways of teaching. There are
some Engineering colleges and MBA colleges that have still left to match with
the evolving world. This is the reason why students prefer studying abroad
first is quality education and second is high employment rates.
